reason: The plan meets every hard requirement (12 numbered steps, rehearsal on staging data, post-cutover row-count/checksum verification, stakeholder communications, pre-cutover backup before any destructive action, and a concrete rollback tied to the backup) and correctly ends with the required STEP COUNT line.
